notes.title: Happy Birthday Clean Stack ! 🎉
notes.content:
Well, 31,536,000 seconds (or one year, if you prefer 🙄) have passed since the release of Clean Stack (Gamejam version). A few weeks later, I started thinking about working on the game some more to turn it into a full Steam game. Now, a year later, the game is almost ready to be released! 

To be honest, we worked harder over the last month to try and announce the release date on the birthday, but we are not exactly ready enough for this, as I am moving out during the week ! 🙂

A lot of things happened for Clean Stack in the past year. I never expected I would have worked on the game for that long. I added much more than I originally imagined (Counting 1000+ hours of work for the 3 of us), but I also scrapped a lot of the ideas I had originally planned. I tried my best to make good choices and keep the best of the game while leaving the worst behind.

First of all, HUGE huge thanks to Quazquaz and Pacoco for working with me on the game all this time. We're not getting paid for this project, and it's sometimes hard to find the time to work on it in our free time. However, I still believe that we all have fun/learnt a lot from it, and that this project is a significant achievement for the three of us ! 🔥 

So, what's in store for the birthday 😮 ? Nothing! 🎉 💥 💥

Okay, I lied; we have something in preparation. I will soon work on a video about Clean Stack, showing the improvements made to the game during development (Gamejam/Mid-development/Present) ! Hopefully some people will be interested about it 😄

And there's more! I've made some significant changes to the inventory that I think people will be interested in .
The picture showing the content in boxes now adapts to every item, making it clear and easy to see. In addition, the size of each item is specified in the description (items can be Small/Medium/Large).

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45381490/cb47e793e02df0f91783e22a270a6545e9988967.png
Here is the new look of boxes + description

I made sure this information is still present in Hard difficulty! This makes it less random and more about strategy, as you can plan which size of object you need at any given moment

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45381490/0a6ac96f21dcc2aa8115f9194ec223d180a8b8a1.png
Here is the new look of boxes + description, in Hard difficulty

That's all for now! I'm happy to still be working on this project, and I'm grateful to have people following it! As always, I'll share more updates as soon as possible ːreheartː

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45381490/56c1dc13ce553f7c2b4a3e8478a595b1ec35a942.png

notes.title: What's going on here?
notes.content:
Hola, so after a bit of thinking, I think it's about time we say goodbye to Pandev for something new here! 😄

Pandev Studios was founded by a team of three people who worked on The Dark Fever. Since then, I am now the only one left working on new projects from the original group. In new projects the people who helped me were not related to Pandev. So it wasn't absolutely right to use 'Made by Pandev Studios' even if everyone has always been comfortable about it. 😄

I thought it was finally time to do something about this. From now on, the projects I work on will be credited under the name: Babeko. I think it is more right to see me as a solo developer then a studio! 🔥
A huge huge thanks to the original team of Pandev Studios, it was amazing to build something together and it will be part of me forever for sure ❤️

Just a quick note before I continue: the Discord server will be renamed "Babeko - Community". That doesn't mean I'm the only one working on my projects, though! I've made one tiny project alone, but all the rest have been made in teams who have done a huge amount of work to help me (Arts, Musics and more) ! So, think of this as a place/name to gather all my projects rather than the releases of a studio!

All of the previous games I made as Pandev Studios can still be credited as Pandev Studios or Babeko, you choose, Clean Stack will be the first game I will publish as Babeko fully! 🎉 

I took this opportunity to polish the Discord server a bit and to make all the changes on social medias (X and Bluesky) as well as Steam !
Here is the new Babeko Steam group: https://steamcommunity.com/groups/Babeko 

This is a big change and I feel like the spotlight is now more on me since I'm no longer "hiding" behind the name Pandev Studios. But it also feels refreshing, I feel far more represented! Please share any of your thoughts about this change in comments, I will gladly listen to all of them carefully

See you all next time for some Clean Stack news!

- Babeko

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45381490/56c1dc13ce553f7c2b4a3e8478a595b1ec35a942.png

notes.title: Clean Stack news! After a while...
notes.content:
Hey! It's been almost two months since the last Clean Stack news, and I can't deny that time has flown

How is progress on the game going?
We are still actively working on the game almost daily, but our team is struggling to find the time to work on it (we work on it in our free time !), so progress is not as fast as we would like. We are still making progress! When I say progress, I mean that things are really starting to take shape, and we might be able to announce a release date in the next few weeks.
A lot has been done, but a lot remains to be done. Our goal is to provide players with the best possible experience: a polished version of the game that looks and feels like a real game with a place on Steam.

I can't say exactly how the progress will go for now, because some things could help us a lot and speed up the process significantly, but we have no idea when that will happen. That doesn't mean we can't continue working on the game in the meantime.

We want to release the game as soon as possible, but properly. We didn't gave a lot of news about the game because we don't want to speak for nothing and repeat the same things, we also are working on things that can't be really shown and we want the players to still have the surprise in game ! Beside that this message seems negative, in reality the development is still progressing and we are still as passionate and having fun about working on the game. (And I strongly believe that its the most important) 

To thank the people who are still around and waiting for the game to be released, here are two pictures showing the polish and detail we have put into the game recently :

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45381490/6fb81e283c4b9bcf9a5f204c28de464b94424e6d.gif
- Level selector improvement 🫎


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45381490/2ac61457682713be0c2e880872f040ab90c3cde0.png
-  Hard mode's look revamp


The whole Clean Stack Team is always grateful to have people around excited to get news on the game, and yes, its going forward ! 🍌
